description: This file is a Python module that serves as a deprecated aggregator for various AI-related service modules within the 'pipecat.services' package. It imports all symbols from specific service modules and replaces itself in sys.modules with a proxy for backward compatibility, indicating that direct imports from individual service modules are now preferred.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A proxy class used to replace the module in sys.modules for backward compatibility, redirecting attribute access to the underlying modules.

methods.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
methods.description: Constructor for the DeprecatedModuleProxy class, initializing it with the globals dictionary, module name, and list of included modules.
